action_playbook: Zero-cost retention. Offer subscription pause to protect CRM status or share self-help documentation. NO deep discounts.
Light educational nurture. Offer 7-day trial of a productivity add-on to test willingness to expand without eroding core margin.
Strategic executive review. Assign CSM to identify why an enterprise account is under-utilizing our platform. Unlock advanced features for 30 days.
Aggressive Wallet Capture. Offer 20% discount on an annual multi-seat enterprise upgrade bundled with VIP training to replace competitors.
Margin Protection Play. High support tickets with negligible revenue. Strictly zero discount. Provide automated pause or self-serve FAQ.
Monetize Support. Introduce premium support tier or suggest self-service docs to filter out loss-making interactions.
White-Glove Intervention. Assign Senior CS Director, provide 3h customized team training and 1-2 free bonus months to lock multi-year contract.
Proactive relationship reinforcement. Provide quick issue resolution, 15-25% renewal incentive and dedicated technical onboarding.
Capital Lock-In Play. High spenders with low commitment. Pitch 25% off 1-year annual upfront contract to prevent opportunistic churn.
Fast-action incentive. Provide time-sensitive 15% discount for 6-month commitment.
Zero-touch automated nudges. Minimal CAC/CRC spend to avoid negative unit economics.
